title: Auldey Toys Recalls Sky Rover Toys Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The USB charging cords sold with the toy can overheat, posing fire and burn hazards to consumers. Units: About 325,000.

title: 360 Electrical Recalls Surge Protectors Due to Shock and Fire Hazards
summary: The surge protectors can short circuit when non-grounded plugs are connected, posing a shock or fire hazard. Units: About 9,300 (in addition, about 1,000 were sold in Canada).

title: AR500 Armor Recalls Level III Body Armor Due to Risk of Gunshot Injury or Death
summary: The body armor can fail to meet performance requirements for Level III body armor, allowing a bullet to penetrate, and pose a risk of gunshot injury or death. Units: About 10,000.

title: Far East Brokers Recalls Children’s Chairs and Swings Due to Violation of Federal Lead Paint Standard
summary: The screen-printing on the fabric of the chairs and swings contains excessive levels of lead, which is a violation of the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 6,000.

title: Rhino Metals Recalls Handgun Security Safes Due to a Serious Risk of Injury
summary: The handgun security safes can be opened without the use of a combination allowing unauthorized access to a handgun, posing a serious risk of injury to children and others. Units: About 400.

title: Kwik Tek Recalls Sleds Due to Crash Hazard
summary: The front handle bar assembly can break, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 4,200.

title: Focus Bicycles Recalls Spine Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The bicycle seatstay or linkage component parts used to connect the seat tube and rear axle dropouts can be incorrectly sized which can cause the frame to collapse, posing a fall hazard to the rider. Units: About 80.

title: Debco Bag Recalls Ceramic Mugs Due to Burn and Laceration Hazards
summary: The mug's handle can break, posing a burn or laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 150 (in addition, about 24,000 were sold in Canada).

title: Hillsdale Furniture Recalls Children's Bunk Beds Due to Fall Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Bob's Discount Furniture (Recall Alert)
summary: The bunk bed's side mattress support rails can crack or break, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 20,000.

title: LaRose Industries Recalls Cra-Z-Jewelz Ultimate Gem Jewelry Machine Due to Violation of Lead Standard
summary: The "Slider Bracelet" in the jewelry making kit contains high levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health issues. Units: About 175,000.

title: Square Grove Recalls Sit-Stand Desk Converters Due to Serious Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The pneumatic lifting mechanism can pinch or break fingers during assembly or use, posing a risk of serious injury. Units: About 750.

title: Mohu Recalls Boomboxes Due to Burn and Fire Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The boombox can overheat, posing burn and fire hazards. Units: About 1,700.

title: Southwire Recalls Voltage Detectors Due to Shock and Burn Hazards
summary: The voltage detectors can give a false "no voltage" reading when being used to test live wires for electric current, posing shock, electrocution and burn hazards to consumers. Units: About 1.2 million (in addition, 3,640 were sold in Canada).

title: Traxxas Recalls X-Maxx Monster Trucks and Electronic Speed Controls Due to Fire Hazard
summary: Vehicle modification or electronic failure can result in a short circuit, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 4,900 X-Maxx Monster Trucks and 140 VXL-6s electronic speed controls (in addition, 96 trucks were sold in Canada).

title: 3M Recalls Hard Hats Due to Shock Hazard
summary: Hard hats sold online were marketed to protect against electric shock, but they do not provide this protection, posing a shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 7,500.

title: HP Recalls Batteries for HP and Compaq Notebook Computers Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The battery packs can overheat, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 41,000 (In addition, about 2,600 were sold in Canada and about 4,500 were sold in Mexico).

title: October Mountain Products Recalls Hanging Bow Scales Due to Impact and Laceration Hazards
summary: The mounting ring on the scales can break during use, posing impact and laceration hazards to the user. Units: About 640.

title: Ecovent Recalls Room Sensors Due to Shock Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The cover can come off during normal use, exposing high voltage components and posing an electrical shock hazard. Units: About 600.

title: The Land of Nod Recalls Octopus Rattles Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The fabric discs on the tentacles of the octopus rattles can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 550.

title: Tommee Tippee Electric Bottle and Food Warmers Recalled by Mayborn USA Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The warmers can overheat and catch on fire, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 255,000.

title: Sony Recalls VAIO Laptop Computer Battery Packs Due to Burn and Fire Hazards
summary: The lithium-ion battery packs can overheat, posing burn and fire hazards. Units: About 1,700 (in addition, 21 were sold in Canada).

title: Direct Distributors Recalls Angle Grinders Due to Risk of Laceration
summary: The spring-loaded safety switch can fail and allow the grinder to turn on even with the safety switch locked in place, posing a finger, hand or other laceration risk. Units: About 200.

title: Grand Rapids Chair Recalls Chairs and Barstools Due to Risk of Injury (Recall Alert)
summary: The back leg of the chairs can bend and the seat tabs or screws on the seat can loosen. When loose, pinch points between the seat and steel frame are created, posing a risk of injury. Units: About 2,300.

title: STIHL Recalls Battery-Powered Hedge Trimmers Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The hedge trimmer can operate faster than expected, continue running after the trigger is released or operate by depressing either the trigger or the front handle switch individually, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 8,000 (in addition, about 1,000 were sold in Canada).

title: Children’s Nightgowns Recalled by Saro Trading Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The nightgowns fail to meet federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 7,800.

title: Following an Additional Child Fatality, IKEA Recalls 29 Million MALM and Other Models of Chests and Dressers Due to Serious Tip-Over Hazard; Consumers Urged to Anchor Chests and Dressers or Return for Refund
summary: The recalled chests and dressers are unstable if they are not properly anchored to the wall, posing a serious tip-over and entrapment hazard that can result in death or injuries to children. Units: About 8 million MALM chests and dressers and 21 million additional children's and adult chests and dre

title: Polaris Recalls Ranger ROVs Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The ROVs can overheat during heavy engine loading, slow-speed intermittent use and/or high outdoor temperatures and catch fire. Units: About 43,000.
